title: Q-ACTIONS-BILLING: GitHub Actions jobs do not start (account payments failed or spending limit reached)
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** every tick
**Done check:** grep:docs/issues/Q-ACTIONS-BILLING.json::Status:\*\* closed
**Status:** open

Evidence: run 43584148860 (PR 335, head 1357739) failed in 2 seconds with no steps; the check-run annotation reads "The job was not started because recent account payments have failed or your spending limit needs to be increased." Every `checks` run on this repository is affected until it clears.

IDENTITY-BOUND: GitHub billing and the spending limit belong to the owner's own account (money); no session or loop may change them.

Default in effect: the repository's own check set runs in the agent's cloud session before a PR merges (python3 -m foundation design --check, loops, flows, team, agents, writeback, plus the unit suites), the merge proceeds on that evidence, and the server-side tick Worker keeps running on Cloudflare, which does not use Actions minutes.

Closing probe: the `checks` job of a pull request starts and reaches its first step (job steps non-empty); then set this item closed.
